description: Ministry  of Youth and Sports - Cancel the Registration of the Ballroom Dancers Federation of Sri Lanka
reasoning: This gazette content involves the Minister of Youth and Sports exercising powers under the Sports Law No. 25 of 1973 to cancel the registration of a national sports federation. This constitutes a regulatory action under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. While a minister is named, the core content is about regulatory enforcement under statutory authority.
